description: Lemon Squeezy’s official documentation says new seller sign-ups are closed. That rules out activating a new store there and leaves Payhip as a separate candidate for the existing catalogue QA download. The queued work checks payment processor requirements and records the candidate files’ license evidence. Reconsider packaging when a viable seller route and commercial redistribution rights for each essential file are evidenced. Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown.
